# Planet Owl Studio

> Planet Owl is a creative studio building identities, websites, apps, AI solutions and immersive experiences for brands that rise above the ordinary. Based in Padre Garcia, Batangas, Philippines, working with clients remotely.

## What we do
- Design: logos and brand identity, packaging, video editing, 3D motion, websites and UI/UX.
- Develop: web and mobile apps, custom software, e-commerce, databases, cloud, CMS and APIs.
- Digital: content, social media ads, social listening, digital films and SEO.
- AI Tech: assistants, chatbots, automation, generative AI, analytics and integration.

## Plans (one flat monthly price, billed month by month)
- Hatchling, $895 a month: a design team for the brand you are getting off the ground.
- Flock, $1,695 a month: design, plus the content and campaigns that put it to work.
- Nest, $2,995 a month: add the builders: websites, apps and stores, designed and shipped.
- Parliament, from $4,495 a month: the whole nest, with AI and custom software, scoped to you.
- New clients can start with a free 2-week trial.
